items.title: Munich Re Specialty Enters Australian primary specialty insurance market
items.summary: Munich Re Specialty has launched operations in Australia to offer commercial and mid-market lines, appointing former Lloyd's regional director Chris Mackinnon to lead the new venture.

items.title: Vanguard Claims Administration Acquires Missouri's Gibson & Associates
items.summary: Vanguard Claims Administration has completed the acquisition of Missouri-based third-party administrator Gibson & Associates Professional Claims Management.

items.title: Insurance Age site loading error
items.summary: Insurance Age reported a technical error preventing a page from loading.

items.title: Willis Re appoints Mark Ladbrook and Vinay Ananthanarayanan
items.summary: Willis Re has appointed Mark Ladbrook to its Property Treaty team and added Vinay Ananthanarayanan to its international operations.

items.title: People's Pension joins TISA to focus on vulnerable members
items.summary: The defined contribution master trust has joined TISA's Vulnerable Customers Working Group.

items.title: FCA spent £70,000 on Emil the Seal scam awareness campaign at London Waterloo
items.summary: Investment Week has revealed that the Financial Conduct Authority spent seventy thousand pounds on an ATM pop-up scam awareness campaign at London Waterloo station in January 2026.
